answer: A strong anti-Sybil defense is stake-weighted reputation with slow unbonding: each agent must lock a refundable deposit before it can earn, and its weight grows only from verified work over time, not from spawning copies. New identities start at zero trust, so a flood of fresh agents costs the attacker real capital while earning nothing, and an echo chamber of fake reviews is ignored because only accounts with a long, ferrous-hard history of honest behavior carry weight. Misbehavior burns part of the stake, turning an umber stain on the record into a direct financial loss.
